verdict.rationale: Mastra ships built-in scorers/evals (model-graded, rule-based, statistical) and live evaluation to score agent outputs, giving engineering leads a quality-scoring mechanism, but no evidence describes CI pipeline integration, gating, or automated test-run tooling for CI. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, example of running evals as automated tests in a pipeline, independent corroboration of eval accuracy.
